items.stem: A: How do you do? B: ______
items.analysis: How do you do? 是初次见面时的正式问候语，答语仍是 How do you do?；回答 Fine, thank you 的是 How are you?。

items.stem: A: Nice to meet you. B: ______
items.analysis: Nice to meet you. 的固定应答是 Nice to meet you, too.；其余三项分别用于回应感谢、道歉，语境不符。

items.stem: A: Please allow me to introduce myself. I'm Li Ming, from Sichuan University. B: ______
options: How do you do, Mr. Li? I'm Wang Fang.
items.analysis: 对方作自我介绍后，应礼貌回应并作自我介绍；How do you do 是正式场合的问候，符合语境。D 项极不礼貌，B、C 与语境无关。

items.stem: A: Say hello to your parents for me. B: ______
items.analysis: 对方请自己代为问候家人，应答应下来并表示谢意，I will, thanks. 是自然得体的回答。

items.stem: A: This is my friend, Anna. B: ______
items.analysis: 别人介绍朋友时，应向被介绍者问好，Pleased to meet you 是标准表达。

items.stem: 判断正误：用英语介绍两个人互相认识时，通常先把男士介绍给女士、把年轻人介绍给年长者。
items.analysis: 英语介绍的礼节与汉语一致：先把男士介绍给女士，把年轻、地位较低的人介绍给年长、地位较高的人，以示尊重。

items.stem: 补全对话（写出缺少的问句）： A: ______? B: No, I've never been to Beijing, but I'd love to go there some day.
items.answer: Have you ever been to Beijing?
items.analysis: 答语 No, I've never been ... 是对经历提问的否定回答，问句应用现在完成时 Have you ever been to ...?；问的是北京，故补出 Beijing。

items.stem: A: Could I borrow your dictionary for a moment? B: ______
items.analysis: 答应借用时应说 Sure, here you are（当然，给你）；C 用 do 回答与 could 不呼应，D 用于回答感谢。

items.stem: A: What's your major? B: ______
items.analysis: What's your major? 问的是专业，应回答所学专业，I major in computer science 符合；B 回答年级，属于答非所问。

items.stem: A: I failed the math exam again. B: ______
options: I'm sorry to hear that. Don't lose heart.
items.analysis: 听到对方的不幸消息，应先表示同情再给予鼓励，I'm sorry to hear that. Don't lose heart. 得体；B 与语境相反，C 幸灾乐祸，D 用于回答感谢或道歉。

items.stem: A: Excuse me, where is the reading room? B: ______
options: It's on the second floor, next to the library.
items.analysis: 问路时应告知具体位置，A 项既说明楼层又给出参照物，符合指路的交际习惯。

items.stem: A: Have you signed up for the English speech contest? B: ______ I'm a little nervous about it.
items.analysis: 问句用现在完成时，答语应保持一致，用 Yes, I have；后句 I'm a little nervous 说明已经报名。

items.stem: 判断正误：同学说 I've passed CET-4! 时，恰当的回答是 Congratulations!，而不是 Good luck!。
items.analysis: Congratulations 用于祝贺对方已经取得的成绩；Good luck 用于祝愿对方在尚未进行的事情上顺利，此处考试已通过，故用 Congratulations。

items.stem: 补全对话（写出缺少的问句）： A: You look worried. ______? B: I can't find my student card anywhere.
items.analysis: 看到对方神情焦虑时，用 What's wrong? / What's the matter? 询问出了什么事；答语说明遇到的麻烦，语义衔接自然。

items.stem: A: ______? B: I'd like a cup of coffee, please.
options: What would you like to drink
items.analysis: 答语点的是喝的东西，问句应询问想喝什么，What would you like to drink 最贴切；C 问的是看法，D 是一般疑问句，都不能用 I'd like ... 作答。

items.stem: A: How much is this shirt? B: ______
items.analysis: How much 问价格，应直接报出价钱；其余三项均未回答价格。

items.stem: A: ______? B: Size 40, please.
items.analysis: 答语 Size 40 回答的是尺码，问句应问 size；How big 问的是物体大小，How many 问数量。

items.stem: A: May I try it on? B: ______
options: Sure. The fitting room is over there.
items.analysis: 顾客要求试穿，售货员应表示同意并告知试衣间位置；B 生硬拒绝，C、D 与请求无关。

items.stem: A: ______? B: Yes, I'm looking for a gift for my mother.
items.analysis: 这是商店营业员招呼顾客的典型对话，Can I help you? 与答语 I'm looking for ... 衔接自然。

items.stem: 判断正误：在英语中，顾客对服务员说 Give me a coffee. 比说 Could I have a coffee, please? 更礼貌。
items.analysis: 祈使句 Give me ... 语气生硬，在服务场合不够礼貌；得体说法是 Could I have ...? / I'd like ..., please.

items.stem: 补全对话（填入一个恰当的动词）： A: I'm afraid the shirt doesn't fit me. Could I ______ it for a larger one? B: Certainly. Do you have the receipt?
items.analysis: exchange A for B 意为“把 A 换成 B”，正合“换货”语境；change 表示换货时一般不与 for 这样搭配。

items.stem: A: Excuse me, how can I get to the railway station? B: ______
options: Go straight and turn left at the second crossing.
items.analysis: 问“怎么走”应给予具体指路，A 项说明方向和路口，符合交际功能；B 用于回答能否做某事，C、D 用于答谢。

items.stem: A: ______? B: It's about ten minutes' walk from here.
options: How often do you go there
How long will you stay there
How soon will you be back
items.analysis: 答语 ten minutes' walk 说的是距离，问句用 How far；How long 问时间长度，How often 问频率，How soon 问多久之后。

items.stem: A: Does this bus go to the museum? B: ______ You'd better take Bus No. 8.
items.analysis: 后句建议改乘 8 路车，说明这趟车不到博物馆，故用否定答语 I'm afraid not。

items.stem: A: Excuse me, could you tell me the way to the City Library? B: ______ It's next to the People's Park.
options: Sure. Walk down this road and you'll see it on your left.
items.analysis: 对方问路，应指路并补充参照物，A 项与后句 It's next to the People's Park 衔接自然；C 是道谢用语，D 用于接受邀请。

items.stem: A: I'd like two tickets to Leshan for tomorrow morning. B: ______
items.analysis: 售票员在卖票时需要确认单程还是往返，Single or return? 正合语境；其余三项都不符合售票场景。

items.stem: 判断正误：问路时说 Could you tell me where the station is? 比说 Where is the station? 更礼貌，且宾语从句要用陈述语序。
items.analysis: Could you tell me ...? 用情态动词和委婉语气，比直接提问更礼貌；宾语从句须用陈述语序 where the station is，不能写成 where is the station。

items.stem: 补全对话（填入一个恰当的疑问词）： A: Excuse me, could you tell me ______ the train to Chongqing leaves? B: At 8:30, from Platform 3.
items.analysis: 答语 At 8:30 回答的是时间，故宾语从句用 when 引导；注意从句要用陈述语序 the train to Chongqing leaves。

items.stem: A: Hello, may I speak to Mr. Wang? B: ______
items.analysis: 电话中表明“我就是”用 This is ... speaking，这是英语电话的固定说法；I am Wang 是受汉语影响的错误表达。

items.stem: A: Could I speak to the manager, please? B: ______
options: Hold on, please. I'll put you through.
items.analysis: 接线员应请对方稍等并转接，Hold on, please. I'll put you through. 是标准说法；B 生硬且不符合习惯，C、D 与语境无关。

items.stem: A: I'm sorry, Mr. Li is not in at the moment. ______? B: Yes, please. Tell him to call me back this evening.
items.analysis: 对方要找的人不在，应主动询问是否需要留言；答语 Tell him to call me back 正是留言内容。

items.stem: A: ______? B: The doctor is free at three tomorrow afternoon.
options: When can I see the doctor
items.analysis: 答语说明医生有空的时间，问句应问何时能就诊，用 When can I see the doctor。

items.stem: A: I'd like to book a table for four at seven this evening. B: ______
options: I'm sorry, we're fully booked at that time.
items.analysis: 顾客订座，餐厅应说明是否有位；be fully booked 表示“订满了”，符合餐馆应答习惯。

items.stem: 判断正误：打电话时介绍自己说 I am Tom.，询问对方是不是 Tom 说 Are you Tom?，都符合英语电话习惯。
items.analysis: 英语电话中介绍自己用 This is Tom (speaking).，询问对方用 Is that Tom?；I am Tom / Are you Tom 是受汉语影响的常见错误。

items.stem: 补全对话（填入一个恰当的动词）： A: I'd like to ______ an appointment with the dentist for Friday afternoon. B: I'm sorry, Friday is full. How about Saturday morning?
items.analysis: make an appointment with sb 是固定搭配，意为“与某人预约”；appointment 常与 make、keep、cancel 等动词搭配。

items.stem: He ______ me that he would come to the party on time.
items.analysis: tell sb that ... 可接双宾语（tell 后必须跟人）；say 不能直接跟人作宾语，只能说 say to sb；speak、talk 也不能这样用。

items.stem: The coat is too expensive; I can't ______ it.
items.analysis: afford 意为“买得起、负担得起”，常与 can/can't 连用；spend、pay 的主语是人但搭配不同（spend money on sth / pay for sth），cost 的主语是物。

items.stem: We must ______ the environment for future generations.
items.analysis: protect the environment 意为“保护环境”；prevent 意为“阻止”，protest 意为“抗议”，project 作动词意为“投射、预计”。

items.stem: Her words ______ me deeply and I changed my mind at last.
items.analysis: affect 是动词，意为“影响”；effect 作动词意为“实现、使发生”，作名词才是“影响、效果”，是本题最典型的形近干扰项。

items.stem: I'd like to ______ this book for another week.
items.analysis: borrow 是瞬间动词，不能与 for another week 这样的时间段连用；keep 表示“保存、继续借用”，是延续性动词，符合要求。

items.stem: 下列句子中，动词使用正确的有（多选）：
options: He spent two hours on his homework.
It took him two hours to finish the work.
He cost 100 yuan on the book.
She paid 100 yuan for the dress.
items.analysis: spend 的主语是人，常用 spend time/money on sth 或 (in) doing sth；take 常用 It takes sb some time to do sth；pay 的主语是人，用 pay money for sth；cost 的主语是物，用 cost sb money。C 中 cost 的主语不能是人，故错。

items.stem: 用 say/tell/speak/talk 的正确形式填空：He ______ to me about his new job yesterday, and he ______ me that he really enjoyed it.
items.analysis: talk to sb about sth 意为“与某人谈论某事”，符合第一空；tell sb that ... 意为“告诉某人……”，say 后不能直接跟人，speak 一般接语言或用于 speak to sb，故第二空填 told。

items.stem: The doctor ______ him to take more exercise, but he said he was too busy.
items.analysis: 考查 advise sb. to do sth. 这一固定搭配。suggest 与 propose 都不能接不定式作宾语补足语（应说 suggest doing sth. 或 suggest that sb. (should) do sth.）；insist 后接 on doing sth.。只有 advise 符合“动词+宾语+to do”的结构，故选 D。

items.stem: We are all looking forward to ______ from you soon.
items.analysis: look forward to 中的 to 是介词而非不定式符号，其后须接名词或动名词，因此用 hearing。同类须接动名词的短语还有 be used to、pay attention to、devote oneself to、object to 等。故选 C。

items.stem: After a long discussion, the committee ______ the plan because it would cost far too much.
items.analysis: turn down 意为“拒绝（提议、请求）”，与 because it would cost far too much 构成因果；turn up 意为“出现、调高（音量）”，turn out 意为“结果是”，turn over 意为“翻转、移交”。故选 B。

items.stem: The traffic accident ______ careless driving rather than bad weather, as some people said.
items.analysis: result from 意为“由……造成”，后接原因；result in 意为“导致”，后接结果。句中 careless driving 是事故的原因，故用 resulted from。result 作“产生结果”讲时是不及物动词，没有被动语态，C、D 均错。故选 B。

items.stem: You had better ______ the possible risks into account before you sign the contract.
items.analysis: take sth. into account 是固定搭配，意为“把……考虑在内”，其同义表达为 take sth. into consideration。make、bring、put 都不能与 into account 构成这一搭配。故选 D。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with ONE proper word: The two sides argued for hours, but neither of them would give ______, so no agreement was reached.
items.analysis: give in 意为“让步、屈服”，与句中“争论数小时”“未达成协议”相呼应；注意区分 give up（放弃）、give away（赠送、泄露）、give off（散发出）。空白处只需填介词 in。

items.stem: Judge whether the verb collocation is used correctly (√/×): The manager insisted on checking every figure himself before the report was sent out.
items.analysis: insist 只与介词 on 搭配，即 insist on doing sth.，故 insisted on checking 用法正确；与 in 搭配的是 persist（persist in doing sth.）。原句搭配无误，判断为 √。这是 persist in 与 insist on 的典型混淆点。

items.stem: Look! The children ______ football on the playground.
items.analysis: Look! 提示动作正在发生，须用现在进行时 are playing。一般现在时表习惯，一般过去时表过去，现在完成时强调对现在的影响，均与 Look! 的即时语境不符。故选 A。

items.stem: The letter ______ by Tom yesterday evening.
items.analysis: letter 与 write 是被动关系，且时间状语为 yesterday evening，故用一般过去时的被动语态 was written。wrote、has written 为主动形式；is written 时态不符。故选 C。

items.stem: By the end of last year, the company ______ more than 200 new workers.
items.analysis: By the end of last year 表示“到过去某一时间为止”，句子须用过去完成时 had hired，即“过去的过去”。has hired 用于现在完成时；hired 只表过去；would hire 表过去将来。故选 C。

items.stem: ______ from the top of the hill, the small town looks like a beautiful garden.
items.analysis: 非谓语作状语时，其逻辑主语是主句主语 the small town；小镇是“被看”，二者为被动关系，故用过去分词 Seen。Seeing 表主动，To see 表目的，Having seen 表主动且先于谓语动作，均不合逻辑。故选 D。

items.stem: It was in the school library ______ he first met his future wife.
items.analysis: 本句是强调句型 It was + 被强调部分 + that + 其余部分，被强调的是地点状语 in the school library，仍须用 that 连接，不能用 where。判断方法：去掉 It was 与空格后句子依然完整，即为强调句。故选 B。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: If she ______ (leave) home a few minutes earlier, she would not have missed the train.
items.analysis: 主句为 would not have missed，是对过去事实的虚拟，if 从句须用过去完成时 had left（即 had + 过去分词）。这是与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句的固定结构。

items.stem: Judge whether the following statement is true (√) or false (×): Both 'the problem discussed at the meeting' and 'the problem discussing at the meeting' are acceptable English.
items.analysis: discuss 与被修饰名词 problem 之间是被动关系，须用过去分词 discussed 作后置定语；现在分词 discussing 表示主动，说“会议正在讨论问题”时应说 the problem being discussed at the meeting。故后半句不成立，判断为 ×。

items.stem: Many students in our school used to go home at four o'clock, so the library closed at half past four. This term the school decided to keep the reading room open until seven in the evening, and two teachers now take turns to help students with their reading. In the first month, more than 300 students stayed there to read or do their homework. The headmaster says the change costs very little but helps a great deal. What is the passage mainly about?
options: Why the school library used to close early
How a school made its library more useful by extending the hours
How teachers help students with their homework every day
What the headmaster thinks of the students' homework
items.analysis: 全文围绕“学校把阅览室开放时间延长到晚上七点，结果有 300 多名学生留下阅读、写作业”展开，说明这一改动使图书馆更有用。A 只是开头的背景，C、D 只是文中的细节，都不是主旨。故选 B。

items.stem: Every year people throw away billions of plastic bags. They are cheap and convenient, but they stay in the soil for hundreds of years and often end up in the stomachs of fish and birds. Some shops now charge customers for each bag, and many families have begun to carry cloth bags when they go shopping. These changes are slow, but they show that ordinary people can do something for the environment. Which of the following is the best title for the passage?
items.analysis: 文章先肯定塑料袋便宜方便，随即指出它数百年不降解、危害鱼鸟，最后提到限用塑料袋的做法，标题应概括这一“便宜却有害”的矛盾。B、D 与主题无关，C 只涉及文中一两句细节。故选 A。

items.stem: Some people believe that talent decides everything. They point to young musicians who play beautifully without much practice. Yet studies of top performers in music, sport and science tell a different story. Almost all of them spent thousands of hours on deliberate practice, and most of them had teachers who corrected their mistakes patiently. Talent may give a child a quick start, but it is practice that decides how far he or she can go. What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Talent is the most important quality of a top performer.
Young musicians usually practise less than other children.
Practice matters more than talent in the long run.
Teachers should correct students' mistakes patiently.
items.analysis: 末句“Talent may give a child a quick start, but it is practice that decides how far he or she can go”是主题句，前文用研究结果支撑，因此主旨是“从长远看，练习比天赋更重要”。A 与主题句相反；B 属无中生有；D 只是论证细节。故选 C。

items.stem: Last winter a small town in the north was hit by a heavy snowstorm. Roads were closed and villages lost power for three days. Neighbours shared food and firewood, students helped old people clean their roofs, and the local school opened its gym as a shelter. When the roads reopened, many people said they had never felt so close to each other before. Which of the following best summarizes the passage?
options: A snowstorm closed the roads of a small town for three days.
Students helped old people clean the snow off their roofs.
A snowstorm brought trouble to a town, but it also brought the people closer.
The local school opened its gym as a shelter for the villagers.
items.analysis: 文章结构为“暴风雪带来困难（道路封闭、断电）→ 邻里互助 → 人们感到彼此更亲近”，总结应兼顾两方面。A、B、D 都只是文中的某一细节，覆盖面不足。故选 C。

items.stem: Many parents worry that their children spend too much time on mobile phones. They fear that games and short videos will take the place of books. However, some teachers have found another use for the phone. In their classes students use it to look up new words, take photos of the blackboard and share notes with classmates. A recent survey in one city showed that students who used phones mainly for study spent less time playing games than those who used them only for fun. The tool itself is neither good nor bad; what matters is how it is used. What is the second paragraph mainly about?
options: Why parents worry about their children's phone use
Why games and short videos are popular with students
The phone as a useful study tool when it is used properly
The reason why students should not bring phones to school
items.analysis: 第二段列举用手机查词、拍板书、共享笔记等学习用途，并以调查结果说明“用于学习的学生玩游戏更少”，末句点明“工具本身无好坏，关键在于怎么用”，故 C 概括准确。A 属第一段内容；B、D 文中未作论述。故选 C。

items.stem: Nobody likes failure, yet it is often the best teacher. A student who fails an exam and then studies his weak points will do better next time; a businessman who loses money learns where his plan went wrong. The real danger is not failure itself but the habit of giving up after it. Those who succeed are usually people who have failed many times and kept trying. Complete the summary of the main idea with ONE word from the passage: Failure can be the best ______ if we learn from it and keep trying.
items.analysis: 首句即为主题句：“it is often the best teacher”，后文用学生补弱项、商人找失误两例说明失败能教人东西；末句强调坚持。故主旨句可补全为 failure can be the best teacher。答案取自原文首句的核心名词。

items.stem: Two years ago a city introduced 20,000 shared bicycles. At first people loved them: they were cheap, clean and easy to find. But soon the streets were full of broken bikes, and some riders parked them anywhere they liked. The city then set up fixed parking areas, asked the companies to repair broken bikes within 48 hours, and started a points system for riders. The number of complaints fell by half within a year. Sharing works only when everyone follows the same rules. Judge whether the following statement is true (√) or false (×): The main idea of the passage is that shared bicycles are cheaper and cleaner than buses.
items.analysis: 末句“Sharing works only when everyone follows the same rules”才是主题句，全文主线是“共享单车先受欢迎→乱停放、坏车多→出台规则→投诉减半”，主旨是“共享要运转须人人守规则”。“便宜、清洁”只是开头提到的优点，不是主旨，故判断为 ×。

items.stem: Sunrise Community Centre is open from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. from Monday to Saturday. The swimming pool is on the first floor and the reading room is on the second. Children under six must be accompanied by an adult. Bus No. 12 stops right in front of the centre every twenty minutes. On Sundays the centre is closed for cleaning. On which day is the centre closed?
items.analysis: 文中明确说“On Sundays the centre is closed for cleaning”，故周日不开放。周一至周六的开放时间是 9 a.m. 至 9 p.m.。答案 A。

items.stem: The school trip to the science museum will start at 8:30 on Friday morning. Students should bring a notebook and a pencil, but no food, because lunch will be provided in the museum restaurant. The bus will return to school at about 4 p.m. Those who want to join must give their names to Miss Li before Wednesday. What should students bring with them?
items.analysis: 文中说“Students should bring a notebook and a pencil, but no food”，午饭由博物馆餐厅提供，故不必带饭；车费、相机文中未提及。答案 D。

items.stem: A family of four - two adults and two children - visited the zoo last Saturday. Tickets cost 40 yuan for an adult and 20 yuan for a child, but at weekends children under 1.4 metres pay only half price. Both children are 1.3 metres tall. Parking cost the family another 15 yuan. How much did the family pay in total?
items.analysis: 成人票 40×2=80 元；两个孩子在周末身高不足 1.4 米，半价 10 元/人，共 20 元；停车 15 元。合计 80+20+15=115 元。若忘记半价则为 135 元（D 项），只算门票则为 100 元（B 项）。答案 C。

items.stem: The Hope Book Club was started in 2015 by three teachers in a small town. At first it had only 40 books, all donated by students, and members met once a month in a classroom. In 2019 the club moved to the town library and began to lend books to anyone who registered, free of charge. Now it has more than 6,000 books and holds a reading evening every second Friday. The club refuses money from companies, but it welcomes second-hand books in good condition. Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
options: The club was started by a group of students.
The club now has more than 6,000 books.
Members have had to pay to borrow books since 2019.
The club accepts money from companies.
items.analysis: 文中“Now it has more than 6,000 books”与 C 一致。A 与“by three teachers”矛盾；B 与“free of charge”矛盾；D 与“refuses money from companies”矛盾。答案 C。

items.stem: In a study of 500 middle school students, those who slept fewer than seven hours a night were twice as likely to catch colds as those who slept eight hours or more. The researchers also found that the short-sleeping students missed more school days. They suggest that sleep helps the body fight viruses, and that teenagers need about nine hours of sleep a night. According to the passage, students who slept fewer than seven hours a night ______.
options: were twice as likely to catch colds
items.analysis: 文中“were twice as likely to catch colds as those who slept eight hours or more”直接对应 B。A、D 与原文相反；C 属无中生有。答案 B。

items.stem: The mountain railway is 12 kilometres long and was built in 1936. It climbs from 600 metres to 1,900 metres above sea level, and the whole trip takes 50 minutes. In winter the line closes for two weeks for repairs, from 5 January to 18 January, and no trains run at night at any time of the year. Fill in the blank with a NUMBER: The highest point of the line is ______ metres higher than its lowest point.
items.analysis: 线路从海拔 600 米爬升到 1,900 米，最高点与最低点相差 1900-600=1300 米。题目问的是差值而非海拔高度，需作简单计算。

items.stem: Registration for the summer camp opens on 10 May and closes on 30 June. The camp runs for three weeks, from 8 July to 28 July, and is open to students aged 12 to 16. Each student may choose two activities; swimming is the only activity that requires a health certificate. The fee is 800 yuan, and students from rural schools pay half. Judge whether the following statement is true (√) or false (×): A student from a rural school who chooses swimming has to provide a health certificate and pays 400 yuan.
items.analysis: 该生来自农村学校，费用减半即 800÷2=400 元；游泳是唯一需要健康证明的活动，故选游泳须提供证明。两处细节均与原文吻合，判断为 √。注意年龄 12 至 16 岁、活动限选两项也是文中条件。

items.stem: Tom is very generous. When his classmates have no money for lunch, he often pays for them, and he never asks them to pay him back. The word 'generous' probably means ______.
items.analysis: 后一句“同学没钱吃午饭时他常替他们付钱，且从不要求归还”正是对 generous（慷慨的）的解释，属于用例子释义的上下文线索。B 项文中未提及其富裕；C 项与句意相反；D 项与语境无关。答案 A。

items.stem: The shop assistant was very patient with the old lady: she explained the same thing five times without showing any sign of anger. In this sentence, 'patient' means ______.
options: able to wait or repeat calmly without getting angry
items.analysis: 冒号后的解释“把同一件事讲了五遍而毫无怒色”说明 patient 意为“有耐心的”。patient 作名词时意为“病人”，B 项利用一词多义设置干扰，但此处作形容词。故选 A。

items.stem: After the heavy rain, the path became muddy and slippery, so we had to walk slowly and hold on to the trees along the way. The word 'slippery' is closest in meaning to ______.
items.analysis: 由“下过大雨”“泥泞”“不得不慢走并抓住路边的树”可推断 slippery 指路面“滑、容易摔倒”，即 easy to slip on。B、C、D 都无法解释“抓着树慢慢走”的原因。答案 A。

items.stem: The two brothers are quite different: one is outgoing and loves parties, while the other is rather solitary and prefers to spend his evenings alone with a book. The word 'solitary' is closest in meaning to ______.
items.analysis: while 引出对比：哥哥 outgoing、爱聚会，弟弟则“喜欢独自看书打发夜晚”，可见 solitary 意为“好独处的”。B 项与对比关系相反，C、D 文中无据。答案 A。

items.stem: Many small shops have vanished from the main street; where they once stood, there are now coffee bars and clothing chains. The word 'vanished' probably means ______.
items.analysis: 分号后“原来店铺所在的位置如今是咖啡吧和连锁服装店”说明小店已“消失”，故 vanished = disappeared。B、C、D 均无法与“原地改成了别的店”对应。答案 A。

items.stem: Jack is a very stubborn boy: once he has made up his mind, he will not change it, no matter what others say. Fill in the blank with ONE word from the passage: The word 'stubborn' means that a person will not ______ his mind easily.
items.analysis: 冒号后的解释“一旦下定决心，无论别人怎么说都不会改变”正是 stubborn（固执的）的含义，且原文用了 will not change it 这一表达，故填 change，构成 change one's mind 的固定搭配。

items.stem: His answer was far from satisfactory, so the teacher asked him to try again. Judge whether the following statement is true (√) or false (×): In this sentence 'far from satisfactory' means 'not satisfactory at all'.
items.analysis: far from 意为“远非、完全不”，表否定；后半句“老师让他再试一次”也印证答案并不令人满意。故 far from satisfactory = not satisfactory at all，判断为 √。

items.stem: Anna got up at five, took two buses and arrived at the office at seven, a full hour before anyone else. She put the report on her manager's desk and left a note: 'Please read page 3 first - the figures there need your decision.' What can we infer about Anna?
options: She was late for work that day.
She wrote the report in the office.
items.analysis: 五点起床、换乘两趟车、提前一小时到岗，说明她勤奋；把报告放好并留言提醒先看关键页，说明她考虑周到。B 无据；C 与“提前一小时到”相反；D 与“把报告放在桌上”不符。答案 A。

items.stem: When Maria joined the college debating club, she could hardly look at the audience. Two years later she led her team to the city final. "The club did not give me a voice," she says. "It gave me a room where I had to use the one I already had." What does Maria suggest about the club?
options: It chose her as team leader in her first year.
It gave her regular chances to speak in front of others.
It paid for her travel to the city final.
It turned her into a completely different person.
items.analysis: 定位她说的话：俱乐部没有“给她声音”，而是“给了一个必须使用她自己声音的房间”，即提供反复开口的场合。C 项“选她当队长”与“两年后才带队”矛盾；B 项文中无据；D 项被她“the one I already had”直接否定。

items.stem: The notice on the shop door said: 'Back at 2:30. Please leave parcels at No. 8 next door.' It was 1:50 when I got there. What can we infer from the notice?
options: The owner is away on holiday.
The shop has moved to No. 8.
The shop is closed at the moment.
items.analysis: 店主留言“2:30 回来”，而“我”1:50 到达，说明此刻店内无人、店铺暂闭。B 曲解了“把包裹放到 8 号”；C 属过度推断；D 与“可把包裹放到隔壁 8 号”矛盾。答案 A。

items.stem: The sign on the reading-room door says that it closes at nine. Yet every evening the lights go out at half past eight, and the last readers are asked to leave. What can be inferred from the passage?
options: The last readers refuse to leave the building.
The reading room is closed in the morning.
The sign was printed many years ago.
Readers are in fact asked to leave earlier than the sign promises.
items.analysis: Yet 引出与告示相反的事实：灯 8:30 熄、最后一批读者被请走。可推出实际离场早于告示的 9 点。B、C、D 均无文本依据，D 与“are asked to leave”相反。

items.stem: Mr Brown read the letter twice, put it down slowly and said nothing for a long while. Then he stood up and walked to the window, with his back to us. What can we infer from the passage?
options: The letter brought him bad news.
He could not read the letter.
He was angry with the writer.
He wanted to open the window.
items.analysis: “连读两遍、慢慢放下、久久不语、背对着人站到窗前”是典型的受打击后的反应，可推知信中是不好的消息。B 与“读了两遍”矛盾；C 情绪指向不明，文中只有沉默而无怒色；D 只抓住字面动作。答案 A。

items.stem: After the new bike lanes were painted, the number of cars on Bridge Street fell by a fifth in six months. Shop owners there say, however, that their sales have not changed. "People still come," said one, "but they stop more often, because parking is easier now." What can be inferred about the shop owners?
options: They want the bike lanes to be removed.
They had expected the change to cost them customers.
Most of their customers now come by bicycle.
Their sales have risen by a fifth.
items.analysis: however 转折、“sales have not changed”的宽慰语气，预设了原本担心顾客流失。文中未提店主反对车道，故 A 过度；B 把“汽车减少 1/5”错记为“销售上升”；C 只说“停车更方便”，不能推出多数人骑车。

items.stem: A: Did you enjoy the film? B: Well, I looked at my watch four times in the first hour. What does B mean?
options: He had an appointment at four.
items.analysis: B 没有直接回答，而是说“头一个小时看了四次表”，暗示他急于离开、觉得影片乏味，这是英语中典型的含蓄否定。B 与暗示相反；C 把 four times 误解为“四点”；D 与语境无关。答案 A。

items.stem: My grandfather keeps a notebook of every repair he has made to his old radio. Page after page records the same small jobs: cleaning a switch, tightening a screw. When I asked him why, he said, "A radio that is mended is a radio that is known." What does the notebook suggest about the grandfather?
options: He is planning to sell the radio.
He has forgotten how the radio works.
He believes new radios are better made.
He values understanding the machine more than replacing it.
items.analysis: 引语“修好的收音机才是被了解的收音机”说明修理是理解机器的过程；满本记录体现长期投入，而非变卖或遗忘。B、C 与“记录每次小修”的事实相反。

items.stem: In the 'walking school bus' programme, children walk to school in a group led by two parents, picking up more children at each corner on the way. There are no fares, no waiting for a bus in the rain, and the children get twenty minutes of exercise before their first lesson. Schools that have tried it report fewer late arrivals and fewer traffic jams at the gate. It is hard to see how anyone could ask for more. What is the writer's attitude towards the programme?
items.analysis: 末句“It is hard to see how anyone could ask for more”（很难想象还能要求更多）是明显的赞同，加之文中列举不收费、不淋雨、锻炼身体、迟到减少等好处，态度为支持。故选 D。

items.stem: Parents often complain that teenagers spend too long on their phones. Yet the same parents think nothing of checking their own messages during dinner. Before we blame the young, we should look at the example we set. What is the writer's attitude towards the parents' complaint?
items.analysis: Yet 引出对照：父母自己也刷手机；末句“Before we blame the young, we should look at the example we set”是委婉的批评与质疑，而非赞同。作者始终在讨论此事，不是漠不关心（C），语气是严肃的（非 D）。

items.stem: Old glass bottles can be melted down and made into new ones again and again, and this uses far less energy than making glass from sand. Every family can help simply by putting bottles into the right bin. If we all did this, the rubbish problem in our cities would be much smaller. What is the writer's attitude towards recycling glass?
items.analysis: 文中说回收玻璃“耗能少得多”，并号召“每个家庭都能帮上忙”，还指出这样做垃圾问题会小得多，可见作者支持回收。B、C 文中无据；D 与“every family can help”的鼓励语气相反。故选 A。

items.stem: The student union is collecting used textbooks for the village school. Bring them to Room 204 before Friday. Every book you no longer need is a lesson someone else can afford. What is the purpose of this notice?
options: To explain the rules of a new course.
To ask students to donate used books.
To report the results of an examination.
items.analysis: 文体为通知：collecting used textbooks、Bring them to Room 204 before Friday 是明确的行动要求；末句用“别人上得起的一堂课”打动读者，目的是募书。其余三项均无对应信息。

items.stem: According to a survey of 1,200 office workers, 62% said they check work messages within ten minutes of waking up, and 41% said they had answered a work call during a family meal. The report does not say whether this is good or bad; it simply describes how mobile technology has changed the working day. What is the tone of the passage?
items.analysis: 文中只罗列调查数据，并明确声明“报告并未说这是好是坏，只是描述移动技术如何改变了工作日”，不掺入个人评价，故语气是客观的。B、D 带主观情绪，C 无幽默表达。故选 A。

items.stem: Anyone who calls this film "slow" has missed the point. Nothing much happens, it is true, but the camera stays on faces long enough for us to see what a family hides from itself. I have watched it twice and found more each time. What is the writer's tone?
items.analysis: 开篇反驳“slow”的批评，but 后转为赞赏（镜头让我们看见家庭的隐情），“watched it twice and found more each time”是推崇。作者承认情节少（it is true），但这不是客观陈述（C），也无嘲讽（D）。

items.stem: The new study app promises to help students concentrate, but it sends a notification every ten minutes, and each notification invites the user to open a chat, a shop or a short video. In one test, students who used the app spent an average of 47 minutes a day on things that had nothing to do with their studies. Some help! What is the writer's attitude towards the app?
items.analysis: 转折词 but 之后全是指责：每十分钟推送一次、把人引向聊天和短视频、平均每天 47 分钟与学习无关；末句“Some help!”是反语，意为“真是帮了大忙（反话）”。故态度为批评。B 与文意相反；C、D 文中无据。故选 A。

items.stem: The new app promises to cut waiting times at clinics by half. The early numbers look impressive, but they come from three large hospitals with fast internet. Whether a small clinic in a mountain town will see the same result is another question. What is the writer's attitude towards the app?
items.analysis: but 与末句“is another question”表明作者认可初步数据（look impressive），但怀疑其可推广性，属谨慎保留。若完全反对就不会说数据 impressive；若热情就不会质疑山区小诊所。

items.stem: The ______ of the new bridge took the workers three years.
items.analysis: 空格前有定冠词 the、后有介词短语 of the new bridge，此处须填名词作主语，故用 construction（建造、施工）。construct 是动词，constructive 是形容词，constructed 是过去分词。故选 D。

items.stem: The little shop that opened ten years ago has grown into a ______ business with forty employees. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: 空格在冠词 a 与名词 business 之间，只能是形容词作定语。success 为名词、succeed 为动词、successfully 为副词，均不能修饰名词。

items.stem: She sang the song ______ and everyone in the hall stood up to clap.
items.analysis: 空格修饰动词 sang，须用副词，故填 beautifully。beautiful 是形容词，beauty 是名词，beautify 是动词。故选 B。

items.stem: He answered the judge's question ______ and sat down. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: 空格修饰动词 answered，须用副词 correctly。correct 是形容词、correctness 是名词、correcting 不能作状语修饰谓语。

items.stem: We were ______ impressed by the children's performance that evening.
items.analysis: 空格修饰过去分词 impressed，须用副词 deeply（深深地）。deep 作副词时多表空间深度（dig deep），不修饰 impressed；depth 是名词，deepen 是动词。故选 D。

items.stem: The committee's ______ to close the branch was welcomed by most of the staff. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: 空格前有所有格 the committee's，后接不定式 to close，需名词作中心词，故用 decision（a decision to do sth）。decide 是动词，decided 是过去式/过去分词或形容词，decidedly 是副词，均不能作被所有格修饰的名词。

items.stem: There has been a ______ increase in the number of people shopping online.
items.analysis: 空格位于冠词 a 与名词 increase 之间，须填形容词作定语，故用 remarkable（显著的）。remark 可作名词或动词，remarkably 是副词，remarked 是过去分词。故选 B。

items.stem: Her explanation was so ______ that everyone understood at once. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: so ... that 结构中 so 后接形容词作表语，主语 explanation 需要 clear。clarity 是名词（不能作表语接受 so 修饰）、clearly 是副词、clarify 是动词。

items.stem: It took us nearly two hours to ______ the top of the mountain.
items.analysis: reach 是及物动词，可直接接宾语 the top of the mountain。arrive 须说 arrive at/in；get 须说 get to；come 须说 come to。故选 D。

items.stem: After three years in the same position, he ______ a decision to leave the company. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: make a decision 是固定搭配。do、put、get 均不能与 decision 构成英语习惯搭配（take a decision 属英式偶见用法，本题按通用搭配取 make）。

items.stem: The book is well ______ reading; you will learn a lot from it.
items.analysis: be worth doing sth. 意为“值得做某事”，worth 后直接接动名词。worthy 须说 be worthy of sth. 或 be worthy to be done；worthwhile 通常说 It is worthwhile to do/doing sth.；worthless 意为“无价值的”，与后半句“你会从中学到很多”矛盾。故选 C。

items.stem: The doctor advised him to ______ smoking for the sake of his health. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: give up 意为“放弃（习惯）”，与 smoking 搭配。give in 指屈服让步；give out 指分发/耗尽；give off 指散发（气味、光），语义均不合。

items.stem: We must ______ full use of the limited time we have left.
items.analysis: make full use of sth. 意为“充分利用某物”，是固定搭配。take use of、get use of、have use of 均不成立。故选 D。

items.stem: After long talks, the two countries finally reached an ______ on trade. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: reach an agreement 是“达成协议”的固定搭配，与 on trade 呼应。arrangement 常用 make arrangements；argument 指争论，与 finally 的积极结果矛盾；announcement 不与 reach 搭配。

items.stem: Don't ______ it for granted that your parents will always be there to help you.
items.analysis: take sth. for granted 是固定搭配，意为“认为……理所当然”。think 后接从句时不用 for granted；regard 须说 regard sth. as sth.；make 不能与 for granted 搭配。故选 B。

items.stem: Her voice was so low that I could hardly ______ what she was saying. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: make out 意为“听清、辨认出”，与 voice low、hardly 构成合理语义。make up 指编造/化妆/和好；make for 指走向；make off 指匆匆逃走。

items.stem: The city opened a new subway line last month. ______ For example, it now takes only twenty minutes to get from the railway station to the airport, while the same trip used to take more than an hour. Choose the sentence that best fits the blank.
options: Many people still drive to work every day.
The line has made travelling across the city much easier.
The tickets on the new line are quite expensive.
The line was built by a foreign company.
items.analysis: 空后 For example 引出的例子是“同样的路程过去要一个多小时，现在只要二十分钟”，说明新线路使出行更方便，B 与例子构成总—分关系。A 与下文无关；C 谈票价，例子未涉价格；D 谈承建方，无法与 For example 衔接。故选 B。

items.stem: Many students find the first week of college exciting. (1)______ They must learn new routes, new names and new rules, and by Friday most of them are exhausted. Choose the sentence that best fills gap (1).
options: For example, the library is very large.
In the end, nobody agrees with them.
Therefore, they stay at home all week.
items.analysis: 后句列举“记路线、记名字、记规则”直到“筋疲力尽”，正是对“累”的具体说明；But 与前句 exciting 构成转折。B、C、D 均无法被后句解释，D 还与“they must learn”矛盾。

items.stem: Some students study late into the night before an exam. ______ In fact, scientists have found that a tired brain remembers less than a rested one. Choose the sentence that best fits the blank.
options: They believe that the more hours they spend, the better they will do.
They usually go to bed before ten o'clock.
They think that sleep is a waste of time for young people.
They never read their notes again after class.
items.analysis: 空后 In fact 引出与前面看法相反的科学研究（疲劳的大脑记得更少），故前面应是被研究反驳的“熬夜党”的想法：学习时间越长成绩越好。B 与“学到深夜”矛盾；C 与 In fact 后的对比不搭；D 与语境无关。故选 A。

items.stem: Keep a small notebook by your bed. (1)______ Ideas that seem clear at midnight are often gone by morning. Choose the sentence that best fills gap (1).
options: Read it before you go to sleep.
Write down any thought that comes to you.
Buy a bigger desk for your room.
Morning is the best time to study.
items.analysis: 空前说床头放本子，空后说“半夜清楚的想法到早上就没了”，中间必须提出“随手记下”的动作，才能与 notebook 呼应。B 的 read it 无先行词可指，C、D 与“想法消失”无衔接。

items.stem: Air travel has become much cheaper in the past twenty years. ______ People who once spent a whole week on a train now cross the country in two hours, and students often fly to cities they have only read about. Choose the sentence that best fits the blank.
options: However, planes are still thought to be dangerous.
As a result, the way people travel has changed completely.
Trains, on the other hand, are also becoming faster.
Few people can afford a plane ticket today.
items.analysis: 空后举的两个例子（一周的火车行程变成两小时、学生常飞去陌生城市）都是“出行方式彻底改变”的具体表现，与 B 构成概括—例证关系，As a result 也与前句的“票价变便宜”形成因果。A 的转折与例子方向相反；C 转向火车，例子讲的是坐飞机；D 与“变便宜”矛盾。故选 B。

items.stem: The old theatre was built in 1921 and has not been repaired since. (1)______ Last winter, part of the roof fell into the empty seats. Choose the sentence that best fills gap (1).
options: It was designed by a famous architect.
The seats are made of wood.
items.analysis: 空前“1921 年建成、此后未修”与空后“屋顶塌落”之间需要一个概括现状的判断句，Its 指代 the old theatre，形成衔接。A 讲设计者、B 讲票价、C 讲座椅材质，都无法引出“塌落”这一结果。

items.stem: ______ For one thing, it is cheap; for another, it does not pollute the air. Above all, riding it gives a person good exercise every day. Choose the sentence that best fits the blank.
options: Riding a bike in big cities can be dangerous.
Most people would rather take a bus.
items.analysis: 空后 For one thing... for another... Above all 列举自行车的三项优点（便宜、不污染、能锻炼），故总起句应是“自行车有很多优点”。B、C、D 都是缺点或他选，与列举的优点在逻辑上不一致。故选 A。

items.stem: Some people learn best by listening, others by reading. (1)______ A short test can tell you which type you are, and knowing it may save you hours of wasted effort. Choose the sentence that best fills gap (1).
options: Most people prefer films to books.
Reading is always slower than listening.
Neither type is better than the other, but the difference matters.
items.analysis: 空后提出“测试能测出你属于哪一型、了解它能省时间”，前提是承认两种类型有别且都有价值。D 的 always 绝对化且与“各有优势”的语境不合；A、B 另起话题。

items.stem: My grandfather is eighty years old, but he still gets up at six every morning and walks for an hour in the park, rain or shine. He has not been to hospital for ten years. 'Regular exercise,' he says, 'is what keeps me ______.'
items.analysis: 上文“每天六点起床、风雨无阻走一小时”“十年没进医院”都在强调身体好，与 healthy 形成复现关系。busy 与“散步”无关；tired 与“十年没进医院”矛盾；quiet 无从体现。故选 D。

items.stem: Anna had forgotten her umbrella, so she waited under the roof of a shop until the rain ______. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: so 表示因果：忘带伞→在屋檐下等，等到雨“停”才能走。started/poured 会让“等待”失去意义，fell 与 the rain 搭配时指下雨，也与“等”矛盾。

items.stem: Jane had been working in the garden since eight in the morning. When she finally sat down on the sofa at four in the afternoon, she was so ______ that she fell asleep with the television still on.
items.analysis: 从早上八点干到下午四点，坐下就睡着且电视还开着，这些细节都指向“疲劳”，与 tired 呼应。hungry 文中无任何提示；excited、angry 与“睡着”矛盾。故选 C。

items.stem: The soup was far too ______ to drink, so he left it on the table to cool for a few minutes. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: 后半句“放桌上晾几分钟”是明确线索，只有“太烫”才需要 cool。cold 与 cool 方向相反；sweet、thick 都不会因为放凉而改变。

items.stem: For many students the biggest problem is not the exam itself but the ______ before it. They cannot sleep well, cannot eat properly, and feel nervous all the time.
items.analysis: 后文“睡不着、吃不下、一直紧张”正是焦虑（anxiety）的具体表现，属于解释性复现；excitement 是正面情绪，与 cannot sleep 等负面细节不符；holiday、result 与“考试之前”的心理状态无关。故选 D。

items.stem: The first time I gave a speech, my hands shook so much that I could not read my notes. My teacher told me to look at one friendly face in the front row. It worked: by the end I was ______ the whole room. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: It worked 表明紧张被克服：从“只敢看一张友善的脸”到“面向全场讲话”。addressing the room 意为“对全场讲话”。avoiding 与 worked 相反，copying、leaving 与演讲场景不合。

items.stem: When the lights suddenly went out, the whole building was in complete ______. People could not even see the door and shouted in fear.
items.analysis: “灯突然灭了”“连门都看不见”直接解释 darkness；in complete silence 与“惊叫”矛盾；in order 意为“有秩序”，与混乱相反；danger 虽不算错，但前文给的是“看不见”这一视觉细节，与黑暗对应更紧。故选 C。

items.stem: Every spring the town holds a seed swap. Gardeners bring seeds they have saved and take home seeds they have never tried. No money changes hands. The point is not to save money but to keep old varieties ______. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: not ... but ... 给出真正目的：让老品种继续被种植、流传，即 keep ... alive。前文“交换、不收钱”排除了 cheap；secret 与“公开交换”矛盾；rare 是“稀有”，而交换的目的恰是让它们不再稀少。

items.stem: The print on the medicine box was very small, so she ______ her glasses and began to read it carefully.
items.analysis: put on 强调“戴上”这一动作，与“字太小、于是戴上眼镜再看”的动作顺序吻合；wear 表状态，不能与 then began 构成先后动作；dress 的宾语是人；take off 意为“摘下”，与后文“仔细看”矛盾。故选 D。

items.stem: Please ______ your seat belt before the car moves. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: fasten the seat belt 是“系安全带”的固定搭配。tie 指用绳打结，lock 指上锁，close 指关闭，都不能与 seat belt 构成习惯搭配。

items.stem: The doctor warned him that if he did not ______ smoking, his cough would get much worse.
items.analysis: give up 意为“放弃、戒除”，give up smoking 即“戒烟”，与咳嗽加重的警告呼应。give in 意为“让步”；give out 意为“分发、耗尽”；give away 意为“赠送、泄露”，均不能与 smoking 搭配表示“戒”。故选 C。

items.stem: He ______ a shower before breakfast every morning. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: take a shower 是固定搭配（英式亦可用 have a shower）。make/did/get 均不与 a shower 搭配。

items.stem: The two sisters ______ a small room near the university, so they take turns to cook and clean.
items.analysis: share a room 意为“合住一个房间”，与后句“轮流做饭打扫”构成因果。live 是不及物动词，须说 live in a room；use 不能体现“两人共同使用一个房间”的相互性；take a room 意为“租下一个房间”，与“轮流”不搭。故选 B。

items.stem: The manager ______ a short speech at the opening ceremony. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: deliver a speech 意为“发表演讲”，也可用 give a speech。say 后接说话内容，speak 不与 a speech 搭配（speak 作不及物），tell 需接人作宾语（tell sb sth）。

items.stem: When his son won the first prize in the contest, Mr Wang was so ______ of him that he told everyone he met.
items.analysis: be proud of sb. 意为“为某人自豪”，与“逢人便讲”的行为一致。be afraid of 意为“害怕”，be fond of 意为“喜爱”，be tired of 意为“厌烦”，三者都无法解释儿子获奖后父亲四处炫耀的反应。故选 D。

items.stem: The doctor ______ him to take a week off work. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: advise sb to do sth 是“动词+宾语+不定式”结构。suggest 常用 suggest doing / suggest that...；propose 常用 propose doing 或 propose that...；insist 接 on doing 或 that 从句，三者都不能直接接 sb to do。

items.stem: It was raining hard all morning. ______, we decided to stay at home and watch a film instead of going out.
items.analysis: 前句“下大雨”是后句“决定待在家里”的原因，前后为因果关系，用 Therefore（因此）。However 表转折，Besides 表递进，Otherwise 表“否则”，均不合逻辑。故选 A。

items.stem: He studied hard for the whole term; ______, he passed the exam without difficulty. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: 前后为因果：努力→轻松通过，故用 therefore。however 表转折，otherwise 表“否则”，besides 表递进补充，都与“通过考试”这一结果不符。

items.stem: He had studied very hard for the exam; ______, he failed it in the end.
items.analysis: “努力复习”与“最终没及格”是相反、出乎意料的关系，须用 however 表转折。therefore 与 so 表结果，会得出“努力所以不及格”的错误逻辑；because 引导原因，不能这样独立使用。故选 B。

items.stem: The room was small. ______, it was comfortable and quiet. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: small 是缺点，comfortable and quiet 是优点，前后为转折，故 However。Therefore 表结果，Moreover 表递进（同类信息），For example 表举例。

items.stem: Take an umbrella with you; ______ you will get wet on the way to the station.
items.analysis: otherwise 意为“否则”，表示“如果不带伞”将会产生的相反结果，与祈使句 Take an umbrella 构成“正说—反说”的关系。therefore 表结果，besides 表递进，however 表转折，都不能连接“要求”与“反面后果”。故选 D。

items.stem: ______ the heavy rain, the football match went on as planned. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: “大雨”与“比赛照常进行”是让步关系：尽管下雨仍进行，故 Despite（后接名词）。Because of 表原因，会变成“因为下雨所以进行”；Instead of 后接被替代的对象；Thanks to 表正面原因。

items.stem: ______ the weather was terrible, they went on with the climb and reached the top before dark.
items.analysis: “天气很糟”与“继续攀登并登顶”是让步关系，用 Although 引导让步状语从句。Because、Since 表原因，会得出“因为天气糟所以登顶”的错误逻辑；Unless 表“除非”，与句意不符。故选 A。

items.stem: Take an umbrella with you, ______ you will get wet. Choose the best word for the blank.
items.analysis: 祈使句 + or + 陈述句 表示“否则”，即“带伞，否则会淋湿”。and 表示“这样做就会……”，so 表结果，but 表转折，均不合逻辑。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. I asked the librarian for some informations about the evening course, but she said I had to wait until Monday. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: information 是不可数名词，没有复数形式，故 informations 应改为 information。some 用于肯定句表“一些”正确；ask sb for sth 结构完整，asked 后不需 to；特指那位图书管理员用 the 无误。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. There are only five student in my group this term, so the teacher can give each of us more help. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: five 后接可数名词复数，student 应改为 students。five 表数量不用序数 fifth；主语 five students 为复数，are 正确；this term 指“本学期”，无需改 these。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. One of my roommate comes from Yunnan and cooks very well, so we often eat together at weekends. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: one of 后接复数名词，故 roommate 应为 roommates；改后主语中心词仍是 one，谓语用第三人称单数 comes，无需再改 come。my 修饰名词正确；cooks 为实义动词，需副词 well 修饰，well 无误。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. Between you and I, the plan will never work: the budget is too small and the deadline is too tight. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: 介词 between 后须用宾格，故 I 应改为 me。you 的宾格与主格同形，无需改；will never work 表示对未来的判断，时态与语气均正确；never 表强调否定，改成 not 会削弱语义且非错误。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. The government has promised to help the poors in the mountain areas, where many families still live on less than a dollar a day. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: “the + 形容词”可表示一类人，the poor 即“穷人”，没有 poors 这一复数形式。主语 the government 视为单数，has 正确；promise to do 后接动词原形 help；in the mountain areas 表地点，介词无误。

items.stem: Read the sentence and write the correct form of the word in brackets. Last night's storm damaged the ______ (roof) of the two old houses badly.
items.analysis: 两座房子有多个屋顶，需用复数；roof 的复数是规则形式 roofs（不是 rooves），且位于 the ... of the two old houses 之前作中心词，必须与 two houses 的数一致。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. The letters were written in 1920 and kept in a drawer for more than sixty years; today it is displayed in the city museum. Judge the statement: In the passage, the pronoun "it" does not agree with the noun it refers to. (√ / ×)
items.analysis: 前句主语 the letters 为复数，后句用 it 回指同一事物，单复数不一致（改为 they are displayed 才通）。判断代词与先行词是否一致，先找先行词的数，再看代词。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. My sister go to school by bus every day, but on fine mornings she walks with her best friend. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: 主语 My sister 是第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语须用 goes。by bus 是固定表达“乘公交”；every day 与 each day 均可，非错误；go to school 表“上学”，不加冠词。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. I am interested in play football with my classmates, and we meet twice a week on the school field. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: be interested in 中 in 是介词，后接动名词，故 play 应为 playing。主语 I 与 am 一致；interested in 为固定搭配；play with sb 表“和某人一起玩”，介词无误。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. When I arrived at the station, the train has already left, so I had to wait two hours for the next one. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: “火车开走”发生在“我到车站”之前，属“过去的过去”，须用过去完成时 had left，故 has 改 had。arrived 用一般过去时正确；already 用于肯定句正确；arrive at 接小地点，无误。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. The letter was wrote by my teacher last week, and it is still lying on my desk. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: 被动语态由 be + 过去分词构成，write 的过去分词是 written，故 wrote 应改为 written。全句叙述过去的事，was 正确；by 引出动作执行者；last week 是固定时间状语，无复数。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. She suggested to go to the cinema after class, and everyone agreed at once. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: suggest 后不能接不定式作宾语，须用 suggest doing sth，故 to go 应为 going。主句时态由 agreed 可知用过去时，suggested 正确；after class 意为“下课后”，搭配无误。

items.stem: Read the sentence and write the correct form of the verb in brackets. By the time we got to the station, the train ______ (leave).
items.analysis: by the time + 一般过去时从句，主句动作发生在“到达”之前，须用过去完成时 had left。句子已有 got 作参照点，填 left 会破坏先后顺序，填 has left 与过去时间点不匹配。

items.stem: Read the sentence. If I would have known the answer, I would have raised my hand at once. Judge the statement: The sentence is grammatically correct. (√ / ×)
items.analysis: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，从句用 had + 过去分词，主句用 would have + 过去分词。句中从句误用 would have known，应改为 had known；主句 I would have raised 正确。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. He is honest boy who never tells a lie, and all his classmates trust him. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: boy 是可数名词单数，需不定冠词；honest 的 h 不发音，以元音音素开头，故用 an。全句为一般现在时描述性格，is 正确；never tells a lie 语义完整；tell a lie 中冠词不可省。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. I usually go to school by the bike, but when it rains I take the bus. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: “by + 交通工具”表方式时不加冠词，故 by the bike 应为 by bike（也可说 on the bike）。usually 是副词修饰谓语，正确；go 与主语 I 一致；go to school 表“上学”，无需去 to。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. He has been interested on science since childhood, and now he studies physics at university. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: be interested in 是固定搭配，介词用 in。since childhood 与现在完成时 has been 呼应，时态与介词均正确；childhood 泛指“童年”，不加冠词。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. We discussed the problem for two hours and finally arrived to a decision that satisfied everyone. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: arrive at a decision 意为“作出决定”，arrive 表“达成”时接 at。for two hours 表持续时段正确；finally 是副词修饰动词；discuss 为及物动词，不能加 about。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. The sun rises in the east and sets in west, which is why the old house has windows on both sides. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: 表示方位的名词前须加定冠词：in the east / in the west，前后结构应一致，故 in west 应为 in the west。rise 是不及物动词“升起”，正确；主语 The sun 为单数，sets 正确；in the east 无误。

items.stem: Read the sentence and fill in the blank with ONE preposition. He was accused ______ stealing money from the office safe.
items.analysis: accuse sb of (doing) sth 是固定搭配，被动结构 be accused of 同样保留 of。注意区分 charge sb with sth、blame sb for sth，介词不可混用。

items.stem: Read the sentence. Despite of the heavy rain, the football match continued until the final whistle. Judge the statement: The sentence contains an error: "Despite of" should be changed to "Despite" or "In spite of". (√ / ×)
items.analysis: despite 本身是介词，后面直接接名词，不能再加 of；in spite of 才是“介词短语+of”的形式。二者只能择一，故 Despite of 必错。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. She sings very beautiful, and everyone in the village enjoys her songs. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: 修饰动词 sings 须用副词 beautifully，beautiful 是形容词不能作状语。主语 She 为单数，sings、enjoys 正确；her songs 中 her 是形容词性物主代词，无误。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. The soup tastes well, but it is a little too salty for the children. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: taste 在此是系动词，后接形容词作表语，表示“尝起来好”应用 good；well 作形容词只指“身体好”。主语 The soup 为单数，tastes 正确；a little too salty 结构无误。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. Although he was very tired, but he kept working till midnight. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: although 与 but 不能同时使用，二者只能保留一个；保留 Although 时须删去 but。very 修饰 tired 正确；kept working 与过去时 was 一致；从句主语用主格 he，无误。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. He is more taller than his brother, so he always sits at the back of the classroom. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: taller 已是比较级，不能再加 more，属双重比较级错误。than 引出比较对象，正确；主语 He 为单数，sits 正确；sit at the back 是固定表达。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. She spoke so fastly that nobody could follow her, and the teacher asked her to repeat the point. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: fast 的副词形式仍是 fast，英语中没有 fastly 这个词。so + 形容词/副词 + that 结构正确；nobody 在肯定形式的从句中表否定，语义正确；could 后接动词原形 follow。

items.stem: Read the sentence and write the correct form of the word in brackets. Both plans are workable, but the second one is ______ (little) expensive than the first.
items.analysis: than 提示比较级，little 的比较级是 less（不规则），构成 less expensive“没那么贵”。不能填 littler；也不能填 least，那是最高级。

items.stem: Read the sentence. The more you practise, the more easier it becomes to speak in public. Judge the statement: The sentence contains a grammatical error. (√ / ×)
items.analysis: “the + 比较级, the + 比较级”结构中比较级不能再用 more 修饰，more easier 属双重比较级，应改为 the easier。前半句 the more you practise 正确。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. He returned back to his hometown after ten years abroad and found the old street much narrower than he remembered. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: return 本身含“回”的意思，returned back 语义重复，属多余词。after ten years 表“十年之后”，正确；hometown 是一个词；ten years 用基数词，正确。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. She married with a doctor last spring and moved to Chengdu with him. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: marry 是及物动词，marry sb 即“与某人结婚”，不加 with（be married to sb 才是状态表达）。last spring 表“去年春天”，不加 the；a doctor 泛指身份，正确；季节名不大写。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. It was raining heavily, so we decided to go for a long walk in the park. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: 下大雨与“仍去散步”是转折关系，用 so 会造成因果颠倒，应改为 but。rain heavily 是固定搭配；decide to do 后接原形；in the park 表地点，无误。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. The exam was extremely easy. Most students answered only half of the questions, and many of them failed. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: 后文“只答了一半、许多人不及格”与“极其容易”自相矛盾，须把 easy 改为 difficult 才与下文一致。extremely 修饰形容词正确；only half 语义成立；many of them 指可数复数，正确。

items.stem: Read the passage. There is ONE error in it. My father he works in a hospital in the city centre, and he comes home late every Friday. Which correction should be made?
items.analysis: 主语 My father 之后又出现代词 he，属多余词造成主语重复。主语为第三人称单数，works 正确；in a hospital / in the city centre 介词无误；特指“市中心”用 the，正确。

items.stem: Read the sentence. It contains one error. The reason why he was late is because the bus broke down halfway. Write the word that should replace "because".
items.analysis: The reason ... is that ... 是规范句式；is because 与主语 reason 语义重复，属行文冗余/结构不当。改后 The reason why he was late is that the bus broke down halfway，表语从句由 that 引导。

items.stem: Read the sentence. Although the weather was terrible, and the match was cancelled. Judge the statement: The sentence is correct as it stands. (√ / ×)
items.analysis: Although 引导让步状语从句后应直接接主句，不能再用 and 连接并列分句；句中的 and 属多余词，删去后 Although the weather was terrible, the match was cancelled 才完整（语义上也需重新考虑逻辑，或用 but 替换）。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：The book which I borrowed from the library last week is very interesting.
options: 那本有趣的书是我上周从图书馆借的。
我上周从图书馆借的那本书非常有趣。
我上周从图书馆借书，那非常有趣。
上周从图书馆借书对我来说很有趣。
items.analysis: 限制性定语从句的译法。英语定语从句后置，汉语习惯把定语提到先行词之前，译为'我上周从图书馆借的那本书'；B 把主从关系倒置，改变了信息焦点，也丢掉了 interesting 对 book 的修饰；C 把定语从句误作并列分句，先行词 book 被吞掉；D 既漏译 book，又把全句改成'借书很有趣'，主干全错。评分点：先行词还原、定语前置、主句主干（这本书非常有趣）不变。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：English is spoken in many countries around the world.
options: 英语在世界上许多国家被说。
许多国家在世界上说英语。
世界上许多国家都讲英语。
英语说了世界上很多国家。
items.analysis: 被动语态的汉语表达。汉语常用意义被动句或无主句，不必机械加'被'；A 逐字直译'被说'，不合汉语搭配；C 主语与状语错位，'许多国家在世界上'不合逻辑；D 既丢掉被动，又造成主宾错乱。评分点：语态转换、汉语习惯搭配、地点状语归位。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：The problem which was discussed at the meeting has not been solved yet.
options: 这个问题在会上被讨论，还没有解决。
那个没有解决的问题在会上被讨论了。
会上讨论的问题已经被解决了。
会上讨论的那个问题还没有得到解决。
items.analysis: 一句之内两个被动结构须分别处理：定语从句 which was discussed at the meeting 转译为前置定语'会上讨论的'；主句 has not been solved yet 用'还没有得到解决'，'得到'是汉语常用的被动替代手段。B 把主句与从句的时态、逻辑关系完全颠倒；C 漏译 not…yet，正反颠倒；D 拆句后主干丢失，'被讨论'生硬。评分点：两个被动分别处理、not…yet 的否定意义、定语前置。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：Although he was tired, he kept working until midnight.
options: 虽然他累了，但他一直工作到半夜。
他累了，所以一直工作到半夜。
虽然他工作到半夜，但他很累。
他不仅累了，而且工作到半夜。
items.analysis: although 引导让步状语从句，汉语用'虽然……但……'与之对应（英语 though 与 but 不能并用，汉语可以）；kept working 表持续，译'一直工作'；until midnight 译'到半夜'。B 把让步误作因果；C 主从颠倒，强调重心错位；D 把让步误作递进。评分点：逻辑关系（让步）、动作的持续性、时间状语。

items.stem: 判断：英译汉时，英语的被动句一般都要译成带'被'字的汉语句子，否则就是错译。
items.analysis: 汉语被动表达手段多样，除'被'外还有'受、遭到、得到、加以'，以及意义被动句（如'问题解决了'）和无主句（如'会上讨论了这个问题'）。是否用'被'取决于汉语习惯和语义色彩，'被'多带不如意色彩；一律加'被'反而生硬，甚至造成误译。该说法错误。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成汉语，注意定语从句、被动语态以及比较结构中 those 的处理：The measures that the government has taken to protect the environment are considered more effective than those taken by some developed countries.
items.answer: 政府为保护环境所采取的措施，被认为比一些发达国家所采取的措施更为有效。
items.analysis: 评分点（每点 2 分）：①定语从句 that the government has taken 前置，译为'政府所采取的措施'；②to protect the environment 作目的状语，译'为保护环境'；③are considered 译'被认为'，也可转译为'人们认为'；④比较结构 more effective than those 中的 those 指代 measures，必须补出'措施'，不能译成'那些国家'；⑤taken by some developed countries 是过去分词短语作后置定语，译'一些发达国家所采取的'。典型误译：比较对象错位、把 considered 译成'考虑'。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成汉语，注意 hardly 的否定意义和 it takes… 句型的处理：Those who have never experienced failure can hardly understand how much courage it takes to start all over again after everything has been lost.
items.answer: 那些从未经历过失败的人，很难理解在失去一切之后重新开始需要多大的勇气。
items.analysis: 评分点：①Those who have never experienced failure 译'那些从未经历过失败的人'，完成时体现'至今'的经历；②hardly 是否定副词，译'几乎不／很难'，不可当作 hard 译'努力地'；③how much courage it takes to do sth 是 it takes + 名词 + to do 句型，译'做某事需要多大的勇气'，不可直译'它拿多少勇气'；④after everything has been lost 被动转主动，译'在失去一切之后'，按汉语时间顺序前移；⑤start all over again 译'重新开始／从头再来'。典型误译：把 it 当实义主语、把 hardly 译成'努力地'。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：It is no easy job to learn a foreign language well.
options: 学一门外语不是容易的工作。
学好一门外语绝非易事。
学习外国语言没有容易的工作。
一门外语学得好并不是工作。
items.analysis: it 是形式主语，真正的主语是 to learn a foreign language well；no easy job 是英语口语化的评价说法，译'绝非易事'比'不是容易的工作'地道。B 逐字译 job，状语 well 也丢了；C 把 job 误作'工作机会'；D 结构瓦解，句子不成立。评分点：形式主语还原、job 的意译、well 落到'学好'上。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：He did not go to bed until he had finished his homework.
options: 他完成作业之前不上床睡觉，之后才睡。
他没有上床睡觉，直到他完成作业。
他直到完成作业才上床睡觉。
他做完作业就不睡觉了。
items.analysis: not…until 是英语常用否定结构，汉语对应'直到……才……'，须把否定前移为肯定。B 保留 not 与 until 的英语语序逐字直译，不合汉语习惯；C 冗赘且逻辑含混；D 把'才睡'说成'不睡'，正反颠倒。评分点：否定转移、时间状语前置、时态呼应。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：The old man walked slowly into the room. He looked around, but nothing in it was familiar to him.
options: 那个老人走进房间，他周围没有熟悉的东西。
老人慢慢走进房间，环顾四周，但房间对他不熟悉。
老人走进房间，看了看，什么也不认识。
老人慢慢走进房间，环顾四周，可里面没有一样东西是他所熟悉的。
items.analysis: 段落翻译须处理代词指代与主客关系：it 指 the room，familiar to him 意为'他所熟悉的'。B 译成'房间对他不熟悉'，主客颠倒，是典型误译；C 漏译 nothing in it 与 familiar，信息大量丢失；D 丢掉 but 的转折，'他周围'又扩大了原文范围。评分点：代词指代明确、主客关系正确、句际衔接自然。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：The small town is famous for its beautiful scenery and its friendly people.
options: 这座小镇以风景优美、民风淳朴而闻名。
这座小镇因它美丽的风景和友好的人民而出名。
这座小镇著名的风景和友好的人。
这座小镇的风景比人更有名。
items.analysis: 汉语多用四字格与并列短句，A 用'风景优美、民风淳朴'意译 friendly people，符合汉语表达习惯。B 逐字译 people 为'人民'，搭配不当；C 缺谓语，句子不成立；D 把并列关系误作比较。评分点：意译而非字对字、汉语四字结构、主谓完整。

items.stem: 判断：段落翻译应以句子为单位逐句直译，不必考虑句与句之间的衔接和语序调整。
items.analysis: 段落翻译除句内准确外，还须处理句际衔接（代词指代、连接词、重复信息的合并或省略）和语序调整（英语后置定语、状语位置与汉语不同）。逐句直译往往留下'翻译腔'，段落读来不连贯，属较低档次的译法。该说法错误。

items.stem: 将下列段落译成汉语，注意前后时态的对比和 changed beyond recognition 的意译：When I first came to this city ten years ago, there were only a few tall buildings along the river. Now, however, the whole area has changed beyond recognition, and it is hard to believe that it was once a quiet village.
items.answer: 十年前我刚到这座城市时，河边只有几座高楼。然而如今，整个地区已经变得让人认不出来了，很难相信这里曾经是一个宁静的村庄。
items.analysis: 评分点：①when 从句译'……时'，汉语习惯把时间状语前置；②there were only a few 用汉语存现句译'只有几座'；③now 与 however 合并译'然而如今'，体现时间对比；④changed beyond recognition 意译'变得让人认不出来了'，不可直译'改变超过承认'；⑤it is hard to believe that… 用汉语无主句'很难相信'；⑥was once 译'曾经是'，与'如今'呼应。评分维度：内容完整 4 分、语序自然 3 分、无翻译腔 3 分。

items.stem: 将下列段落译成汉语，注意两个宾语从句的顺译和末句反问语气的保留：Many parents complain that their children spend too much time on mobile phones, but few of them realize that they themselves are setting a bad example. If adults cannot put down their phones at the dinner table, how can they expect their children to do so?
items.answer: 许多家长抱怨孩子花太多时间玩手机，却很少有人意识到，他们自己正在树立坏榜样。如果大人在饭桌上都放不下手机，又怎么能指望孩子做到呢？
items.analysis: 评分点：①complain that 与 realize that 两个宾语从句顺译，语序不必调整；②but few of them 译'却很少有人'，保留转折与'少'的否定意味；③themselves 用'他们自己'体现代词强调；④set a bad example 译'树立坏榜样'，不可译'设置坏例子'；⑤put down 译'放下'，at the dinner table 译'在饭桌上'；⑥how can they expect… 保留反问语气，译'又怎么能指望……呢'；⑦to do so 回指前文，译'做到'以免重复。评分维度：信息完整 4 分、语气一致 3 分、衔接自然 3 分。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：他每天早上六点起床。
options: He get up at six every morning.
He gets up at six every morning.
He is getting up at six every morning.
He gets up at six in every morning.
items.analysis: 主语 he 为第三人称单数，一般现在时动词加 -s；every morning 表习惯，用一般现在时而非进行时；'在早上'用 in the morning，但 every morning 前不加介词。B 主谓不一致；C 时态错，进行时不能表习惯；D 介词冗余。评分点：主谓一致、时态选择、时间状语表达。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：我昨天在图书馆遇见了我的英语老师。
options: I have met my English teacher in the library yesterday.
I meet my English teacher in the library yesterday.
I met my English teacher in the library yesterday.
I was met my English teacher in the library yesterday.
items.analysis: yesterday 是明确的过去时间，须用一般过去时 met。B 时态错，一般现在时不能与 yesterday 连用；C 现在完成时不能与 yesterday 这类具体过去时间连用；D 把 meet 误作被动，meet 表示'遇见'时是及物动词的主动式。评分点：时态与时间状语一致、主动语态、地点状语位置。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：这本书值得一读。
options: The book is worth to read.
items.analysis: be worth doing 是固定搭配，worth 是形容词性质，后接动名词的主动形式表示被动意义。B 误用不定式；C worthy 的正确搭配是 be worthy of being done 或 be worthy to be done；D worth 不是动词，没有第三人称单数形式。评分点：固定搭配、动名词主动表被动、形容词与动词的辨析。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：桌子上有两本书和一支笔。
options: There are two books and a pen on the desk.
There is two books and a pen on the desk.
There have two books and a pen on the desk.
Two books and a pen is on the desk.
items.analysis: there be 句型遵循就近一致原则，靠近 be 的是复数 two books，故用 are。B 违反就近一致；C 把汉语'有'直译为 there have，是典型中式英语；D 并列主语表复数，谓语应用 are。评分点：there be 句型、就近一致原则、避免 there have。

items.stem: 判断：'他去年入党了'译作 He joined the Party last year. 是正确的；但不能译作 He has joined the Party for a year.，因为 join 是短暂性动词，不能与表示一段时间的状语连用。
items.analysis: join、leave、buy、die 等属短暂性（非延续性）动词，其完成时不能接 for + 时间段或 since 从句；表示'入党一年'须改为 He has been in the Party for a year. 或 He joined the Party a year ago.。该判断正确。

items.stem: 将下列三句译成英语，注意主谓宾完整、时态一致：①我们学校新建的图书馆上周正式向学生开放。②里面藏书约五十万册。③每天都有很多学生在那里自习。
items.answer: ① The newly built library of our school was officially opened to students last week.
items.analysis: 评分点（每句 3 分，语言 1 分）：①'新建的'用过去分词 newly built 作前置定语，'向……开放'用 be opened to，last week 决定一般过去时且须用被动；②'藏书'用 have a collection of，数量用 about 500,000；③'每天'用一般现在时，'自习'译 study 或 study on their own，不可逐字译成 self-study there 作谓语。典型错误：The library was open to students（open 作形容词，丢了'正式开放'的动作义）、There have many books。

items.stem: 将下列三句译成英语，注意 It takes… 句型、there be 句型与动词时态：①他花了两个小时才完成这份报告。②报告里有一些拼写错误。③他答应明天改好。
items.answer: ① It took him two hours to finish the report.
items.analysis: 评分点（每句 3 分，语言 1 分）：①'花时间做某事'用 It takes sb some time to do sth，叙述过去的事用 took；'才'靠句型体现即可；②'有'用 there be，mistakes 为复数故用 are；③promise to do 后接不定式，主句 promised 过去时，'明天'由 tomorrow 词汇体现，不宜改成 will correct（若要用须写 promised that he would correct them）。典型错误：He spent two hours to finish（应为 spend…doing）、There have some mistakes。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：会议已经被推迟到下周五。
options: The meeting has put off until next Friday.
The meeting has been put off until next Friday.
The meeting is put off until next Friday.
The meeting has put off to next Friday.
items.analysis: '已经被推迟'含完成意义，且会议是被推迟的，须用现在完成时的被动 has been put off；put off 后接时间点用 until／till。B 缺 been，成了主动式；C 一般现在时被动不能表达'已经'；D 既缺被动又误用介词。评分点：完成时被动结构、动词短语的被动形式、介词搭配。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：我到那儿时，电影已经开演了。
options: When I got there, the film already began.
When I got there, the film has already begun.
When I got there, the film had already begun.
When I got there, the film was already begun.
items.analysis: '过去的过去'用过去完成时 had begun，already 置于助动词之后。B 现在完成时与过去的时间从句冲突；C 一般过去时无法体现两个动作的先后；D begin 是不及物动词，不能构成被动。评分点：过去完成时表先后、already 的位置、不及物动词无被动。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：到目前为止，这项工程已经完成了一半。
options: Up to now, half of the project was completed.
So far, half of the project has completed.
So far, half of the project had been completed.
So far, half of the project has been completed.
items.analysis: so far／up to now 要求现在完成时；工程是'被完成'的，须用被动 has been completed。B 缺 been，complete 作及物动词时不能以 project 为主语构成主动式；C 过去完成时须有过去的参照点，与 so far 矛盾；D 一般过去时与 up to now 冲突。评分点：时间状语与完成时的对应、被动语态、half of 作主语时的主谓一致。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：据说这座桥建于明朝。
options: It is said that the bridge was built in the Ming Dynasty.
It is said that the bridge built in the Ming Dynasty.
It says that the bridge was built in the Ming Dynasty.
The bridge is said to build in the Ming Dynasty.
items.analysis: '据说'用 It is said that…，其中 it 是形式主语；'建于'是过去被动 was built。B 缺 was，built 成了主动过去式，从句没有被动意义；C It says 意为'它（文件、标牌等）说'，不能表'据说'；D 不定式须用被动形式 to have been built。评分点：形式主语结构、过去被动、不定式的被动形式。

items.stem: 判断：'这本书已经被翻译成多种语言'译作 This book has translated into many languages. 是正确的，因为 has 后接过去分词即构成完成时。
items.analysis: translate 是及物动词，书是'被翻译'的，须用现在完成时的被动 has been translated into；has translated 是主动式，意为'这本书翻译了……'，逻辑不通。完成时并非只有 has done 一种形式，还须考虑语态。该说法错误。

items.stem: 将下列三句译成英语，注意现在完成时、被动语态与将来完成时的使用：①近十年来，我们城市的面貌发生了巨大变化。②许多旧房子被拆掉，取而代之的是现代化的高楼。③我相信，到2030年，这里将建成一座更大的公园。
items.answer: ① In the past ten years, great changes have taken place in our city.
items.analysis: 评分点（每句 3 分，语言 1 分）：①'近十年来'用 in the past ten years，须配现在完成时；'发生'用 take place（不及物，无被动）；②'被拆掉'用 have been pulled down，'取而代之的是'用 be replaced by；③'到2030年将建成'用将来完成时的被动 will have been built，by 2030 是标志。典型错误：great changes have been taken place（take place 无被动）、a park will build here（漏被动）、in the past ten years 配一般过去时。

items.stem: 将下列三句译成英语，注意过去完成时的被动与 Only then 引起的倒装：①当我到达办公室时，才发现我的电脑被人动过了。②桌上的文件已经被重新排过，但什么也没有丢失。③直到那时我才意识到，昨晚有人来过这里。
items.answer: ① When I got to the office, I found that my computer had been touched.
items.analysis: 评分点（每句 3 分，语言 1 分）：①'被人动过'用过去完成时被动 had been touched，主句用一般过去时 got／found；②并列两个过去完成时被动 had been rearranged 与 had been lost；③Only then 置于句首须部分倒装 did I realize，'昨晚'在宾语从句中作时态呼应调整用 the night before，'有人来过'用 had been。典型错误：Only then I realized（未倒装）、my computer was touched（时态未体现'更早'）、nothing lost（漏被动）。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：这就是我昨天买的那本书。
options: This is the book which I bought it yesterday.
This is the book that I bought yesterday.
This is the book what I bought yesterday.
This is the book that I buy yesterday.
items.analysis: 先行词 the book 指物，关系代词用 that／which，且在从句中作 bought 的宾语，其后不能再加 it；what 不能引导定语从句（它本身已含先行词）；yesterday 要求一般过去时。B 关系代词与 it 重复；C 关系词误用；D 时态错。评分点：关系词选择、从句中不重复宾语、主句与从句的时态。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：他问我是否去过北京。
options: He asked me whether had I been to Beijing.
He asked me that whether I had been to Beijing.
He asked me whether I had been to Beijing.
He asked me whether I had gone to Beijing.
items.analysis: '是否'用 whether／if 引导宾语从句，前面不能再加 that；宾语从句一律用陈述语序；主句是过去时，从句用过去完成时 had been 呼应；'去过某地'用 have been to，'去了某地（尚未回来）'用 have gone to。B 连接词重复；C 从句用了疑问语序；D 混淆 been to 与 gone to。评分点：连接词、陈述语序、时态呼应、been／gone 之别。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：无论你走到哪里，都不要忘记你的家乡。
options: However you go, don't forget your hometown.
No matter wherever you go, don't forget your hometown.
Wherever you will go, don't forget your hometown.
Wherever you go, don't forget your hometown.
items.analysis: '无论哪里'用 wherever 或 no matter where，二者不可叠加；让步状语从句用一般现在时表将来。B 形式重复；C 状语从句误用将来时；D however 意为'无论如何'，不表地点。评分点：连接词选择、状语从句的时态、no matter 与 -ever 的等价关系。

items.stem: 选出最恰当的译文：我永远不会忘记我们第一次见面的那个村庄。
options: I will never forget the village where we first met.
I will never forget the village which we first met.
I will never forget the village where we first met there.
I will never forget the village when we first met.
items.analysis: 先行词 village 表地点，在从句中作地点状语，用关系副词 where（= in which）；where 已含介词意义，从句中不再加 there 或 in。B which 在从句中不作成分，缺介词；C 重复 there；D when 指时间，与 village 不搭配。评分点：关系副词与关系代词的区分、从句成分不重复。

items.stem: 判断：'因为他病了，所以他没来上学'只能译成 Because he was ill, so he didn't come to school.，因为汉语的'因为……所以……'在英语中必须成对出现。
items.analysis: 英语中 because 与 so 不能并用，一个主从复合句只保留一个连接词，应译 Because he was ill, he didn't come to school. 或 He was ill, so he didn't come to school.。汉语关联词常成对使用，英语则不能照搬，这是典型的中式英语错误。该判断错误。

items.stem: 将下列三句译成英语，注意 suggest 后的虚拟语气、only 引起的倒装和 what 引导的表语从句：①老师建议我们每天至少花半小时读英语。②他说，只有坚持不懈，才能取得进步。③这正是我们大多数人缺少的。
items.answer: ① The teacher suggested that we (should) spend at least half an hour reading English every day.
items.analysis: 评分点（每句 3 分，语言 1 分）：①suggest 表'建议'时从句用 (should) + 动词原形；'花时间做某事'用 spend time doing；②宾语从句中 only + 方式状语置于句首引起部分倒装 could we make progress，从句时态与 said 呼应用 could；③what 引导表语从句并在从句中作 lack 的宾语，不可用 that。典型错误：suggested us to spend（suggest 不接不定式作宾补）、only by persevering we can make progress（未倒装）、This is exactly that we lack。

items.stem: 将下列三句译成英语，注意 no matter how 引导的让步状语从句、who 引导的定语从句和 as long as 引导的条件状语从句：①不管遇到多大的困难，我们都不应该放弃。②那些轻易认输的人永远无法体会到成功的喜悦。③我坚信，只要坚持，我们一定能实现自己的梦想。
items.answer: ① No matter how great the difficulties are, we should never give up.
items.analysis: 评分点（每句 3 分，语言 1 分）：①no matter how + 形容词 + 主语 + 系动词，语序不可写成 no matter how great are the difficulties；②Those who… 定语从句用 who 指人，主句谓语 will never experience 与主语保持一致；③宾语从句中 as long as 引导条件状语从句，从句用一般现在时表将来，主句用 will realize。典型错误：No matter how great difficulties（缺系动词）、Those who gives up（主谓不一致）、as long as we will keep on。

items.stem: 你曾得到外教 Mr. Smith 的帮助，现写信致谢。下列开头最恰当的是：
options: Dear Mr. Smith, I want to say something about your help.
Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to express my sincere thanks for your kind help with my English.
Hello Smith, Thanks a lot, bye.
Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to complain about your help.
items.analysis: 感谢信开头须点明写信目的（express thanks for…）并具体到事由（your help with my English）；称谓用 Dear + 头衔／称谓 + 姓氏。B 目的含糊，读者不知来信意图；C 称谓错误（Smith 是姓，不能单用 Hello Smith），语言也过于随意；D 功能错位，成了投诉信。评分点：书信格式（称呼）、开门见山点明目的、语气得体。

items.stem: 你因突发疾病不能参加明天的会议，写信向 Mr. Brown 道歉。下列句子最恰当的是：
options: I apologize that I will not come, and it is not my fault.
I am sorry, but you should understand me.
I am terribly sorry that I cannot attend the meeting tomorrow because of a sudden illness.
I must say sorry, and I hope you will not be angry with me for nothing.
items.analysis: 道歉信须直接致歉 + 说明原因 + 提出补救。A 用 I am terribly sorry that… 引出道歉，because of + 名词短语说明原因，简洁得体。B 用 should 反要求对方体谅，语气失当；C 推卸责任，不合道歉信的功能；D 语义混乱（for nothing），且未说明原因。评分点：致歉句式、原因表达、语气礼貌。

items.stem: 你写信邀请外教参加周六的英语晚会。下列句子最适合作为该信结尾的是：
options: I hope you are fine and your family are all well.
You must come, or I will be angry with you.
That's all. Thank you for reading my letter.
I would be grateful if you could let me know whether you can come by Friday.
items.analysis: 邀请信结尾通常期待对方回复并给出答复期限，I would be grateful if… 是得体的委婉请求。B 语气强硬，违背邀请信的礼貌原则；C 是无效套话，未完成交际任务；D 是通用问候语，与邀请无关，也不能充当结尾。评分点：结尾功能（期待回复）、委婉语气、信息具体（by Friday）。

items.stem: 你就学校食堂问题给校长写建议信。下列句子最能体现'提出建议'这一功能的是：
options: I suggest that the canteen should provide more dishes at reasonable prices.
I think the canteen is bad and I hate it.
You should be ashamed of the canteen.
items.analysis: 建议信的核心是提出可行建议，常用 I suggest that…(should)…／It would be helpful if… 等句式。A 既点明问题方向（菜品、价格），又给出可操作的建议；B 只是情绪化抱怨；C 是与建议无关的背景陈述；D 语气失礼。评分点：建议句式、内容具体可行、语气得体。

items.stem: 判断：感谢信、道歉信、建议信、邀请信都属于应用文，一般应包含称呼、正文、结束语和签名，语言应礼貌得体。
items.analysis: 四类书信同属应用文：格式上须有称呼（Dear…）、正文（点明目的—展开细节—表达期待）、结束语（Yours sincerely 等）和签名；语域上要求礼貌、简洁、得体，避免口语化和情绪化表达。该判断正确。

items.stem: 写作任务：你借了外教 Chris 的一本小说，因故不能按期归还，请给他写一封 100 词左右的电子邮件道歉。请列出写作提纲（按'内容—结构—语言'三个维度），并写出该信的开头句和结尾句。
items.answer: 【内容】①致歉并点明事由：未能按期归还所借小说；②说明原因（如临时出差、书被同学借走未还）；③提出补救：新的归还时间、可否续借、愿意当面致歉。
items.analysis: 评分维度：内容 6 分——致歉、原因、补救三点齐全；结构 4 分——称呼、分段、结束语、签名完整；语言 5 分——道歉句式准确、时态一致（借书用过去时，致歉用现在时）、语气礼貌。易失分点：只道歉不说明原因、不提出新的归还时间、结尾仍用 You must 之类命令口吻。

items.stem: 写作任务：学校图书馆座位紧张、部分同学占座，请给图书馆馆长写一封 100 词左右的建议信。请列出提纲（内容—结构—语言），并写出一个得体的建议句和一个说明理由的句子。
items.answer: 【内容】①说明写信目的与问题现状（考试季座位紧张、占座现象严重）；②提出两至三条具体建议（实行座位预约制、离开超过 30 分钟即清座、延长开放时间或增设自习区）；③表达配合意愿并致谢。
items.analysis: 评分维度：内容 6 分——问题描述 + 至少两条具体建议 + 期待；结构 4 分——四段清楚、有衔接词、格式完整；语言 5 分——建议句式（suggest that…should／It would be helpful if…）正确、语气委婉、时态一致。易失分点：只抱怨不给建议、建议空泛（如 You should improve the library）、通篇祈使句显得不礼貌。

items.stem: 学生会将举办英语演讲比赛，需张贴英文通知。下列通知标题最恰当的是：
items.analysis: 英文通知的标题通常就是 Notice（或 Notice on…），居中书写即可，简洁醒目。B 含糊无信息，读者看不出通知什么；C 文体错误，通知不是书信；D 重复堆砌，不符合应用文规范。评分点：文体标识、简洁性、信息量。

items.stem: 讲座海报中要写明时间与地点。下列表达最恰当的是：
options: The lecture is held in hall at 3 p.m. Friday.
The lecture will be held in the school hall, and the time is 3 p.m., Friday, May 12, and the place is the hall.
The lecture will be held in the school hall at 3 p.m. on Friday, May 12.
The lecture will be hold in the school hall at 3 p.m. on Friday.
items.analysis: 海报信息要简明，时间地点按英语习惯由小到大排列（at + 钟点 + on + 星期／日期），活动用将来时被动 will be held。B 冗长重复，信息组织混乱；C 缺定冠词 the，且一般现在时与'将举办'不符；D will be hold 结构错误，应为 will be held。评分点：信息简明、时间地点表达、被动将来时。

items.stem: 通知中要求全体学生明早七点半在校门口集合。下列句子最恰当的是：
options: All the students have required gathering at the school gate at 7:30 a.m. tomorrow.
All the students require gathering at the school gate at 7:30 a.m. tomorrow.
All the students will require to gather at the school gate at 7:30 a.m. tomorrow.
All the students are required to gather at the school gate at 7:30 a.m. tomorrow.
items.analysis: 通知常用 be required to do／be expected to do 等被动结构表示'要求'，施动者（学校、学生会）隐含不出现。require 表示'要求某人做某事'时须用 require sb to do 或其被动式；B、C、D 都把 require 误作'学生主动要求'，而 require doing 意为'需要被做'（如 The room requires cleaning），与句意不符。评分点：通知的被动句式、require 的用法、时态。

items.stem: 你在阅览室捡到一个黑色钱包，要写一则英文招领启事。下列开头最恰当的是：
options: Found: A black wallet was found in the reading room yesterday afternoon.
Lost: I lost a black wallet in the reading room yesterday afternoon.
I found a wallet, who lost it please come.
A wallet is finding in the reading room yesterday afternoon.
items.analysis: 招领启事的标题用 Found，寻物启事的标题用 Lost，二者不能混用；B 标题与内容矛盾，写成了寻物启事；C 是中式英语，句子结构残缺；D 用进行时表被动，时态与语态均错。评分点：启事类型标识（Found／Lost）、过去被动、信息完整（物品、地点、时间）。

items.stem: 判断：英文通知的正文应写明活动的时间、地点、内容和参加方式，发布单位与日期通常写在正文之后。
items.analysis: 通知属告知性应用文，五要素（时间、地点、内容、参加对象与方式、发布单位与日期）缺一不可；英文通知的发布单位与日期一般写在正文左下方或右下方，也可写在标题之下。该判断正确。

items.stem: 写作任务：校学生会将组织一次敬老院志愿服务活动，请以学生会名义写一则 100 词左右的英文通知。请列出提纲（内容—结构—语言），并写出通知的标题、正文首句和报名方式句。
items.answer: 【内容】①活动名称与目的（志愿者赴敬老院服务，弘扬敬老美德）；②时间、地点与集合方式（本周六上午 8:00 校门口集合，步行前往）；③活动内容（打扫卫生、陪老人聊天、表演节目）；④报名方式与截止时间（向各班班长报名，周四下午 5 点前）。
items.analysis: 评分维度：内容 6 分——五要素齐全、信息具体可执行；结构 4 分——标题、分段、落款与日期规范；语言 5 分——将来时与被动正确、时间地点表达规范、句式符合通知文体。易失分点：漏写集合地点或报名截止时间、把通知写成书信格式（Dear students 后加 Yours）、时态前后不一致。

items.stem: 写作任务：英语角（English Corner）将于每周五晚 7 点在图书馆三楼举行，请写一则英文海报（约 80 词）。请先列出海报要点清单，再写出两条宣传性句子：一句祈使句号召参加，一句突出活动吸引力。
items.answer: 【要点清单】①标题 English Corner；②时间：每周五晚 7:00—8:30；③地点：图书馆三楼；④内容：自由交谈、话题讨论、外教点评；⑤参加对象与方式：全校学生免费参加，无需报名；⑥宣传语与联系人。
items.analysis: 评分维度：内容 6 分——五要素齐全（时间、地点、内容、对象、参加方式）；结构 4 分——标题醒目、要点分条、有收尾宣传语；语言 5 分——祈使句与短句为主、大小写与拼写规范、无中式英语（如 Welcome you to join 应改为 You are welcome to join）。易失分点：把海报写成完整段落文章、时间地点信息遗漏、全篇用陈述句缺乏号召力。

items.stem: 题目：Should College Students Take Part-time Jobs? 下列句子最适合作为该文论点句（开头段末句）的是：
options: Nowadays, part-time jobs are a hot topic, and different people have different ideas, and I will discuss it.
In my opinion, taking part-time jobs does more good than harm to college students.
I like money, so I want to take a part-time job.
Part-time jobs are good, and part-time jobs are bad.
items.analysis: 议论文开头段末句须给出明确、可论证的立场，并限定讨论范围（to college students）。A 用 does more good than harm 表明倾向，一句话立论，便于下文分点论证。B 空泛拖延，始终没有观点；C 以个人喜好代替论证，格局过小；D 自相矛盾，无法展开。评分点：立场鲜明、范围明确、句式可支撑下文。

items.stem: 论述'兼职的好处'这一段，下列句子最适合作为段首主题句的是：
options: First, I have a friend who once worked in a shop and he is very nice.
First, part-time jobs help students gain working experience and learn to manage their time.
First, this is a very important question that everyone should think about carefully.
items.analysis: 段落主题句应概括本段要点，并含有可展开的关键词（gain working experience、manage their time）。A 一句给出两个并列好处，下文可分别举例；B 以个例开头，缺少概括；C 不成句；D 是空话，没有信息量。评分点：主题句的概括性、可展开性、句式完整。

items.stem: 在'兼职的弊端'一段开头，下列句子最恰当的是：
options: However, part-time jobs are also good in many ways.
However, I don't like part-time jobs at all.
However, part-time jobs may also take up too much of students' time and affect their studies.
items.analysis: 转折段的主题句要具体指出弊端所在（占用时间、影响学业），并与上一段形成对照。B 只表达个人好恶，不能支撑论证；C 是万能空话，没有进入本段论点；D 与'弊端'段方向相反，造成段落自相矛盾。评分点：转折词使用、论点具体、与上下段逻辑一致。

items.stem: 下列句子最适合作为该文结论段末句的是：
options: In conclusion, college students should take part-time jobs as long as they can keep a balance between work and study.
In conclusion, I have talked about the advantages and disadvantages above.
In conclusion, you must take part-time jobs, or you will fail in the future.
In conclusion, that's all I want to say.
items.analysis: 结论段须重申立场并给出条件或建议，A 用 as long as 引出条件，观点有分寸、可站得住。B 只复述写作过程，没有结论；C 绝对化，缺乏论证支持；D 是口语化收场语，不符合书面议论文语体。评分点：重申观点、条件限定、书面语体。

items.stem: 判断：写议论文时，只要观点正确、立场鲜明，即使没有论据和例子，也能得到高分。
items.analysis: 议论文评分从'内容—结构—语言'三方面进行，内容分取决于论点是否有论据支撑（事实、数据、事例、道理）。只有立场没有论证，属于'有观点无展开'，通常只能拿到较低档次分数。该判断错误。

items.stem: 写作任务：以 Online Learning: Advantages and Disadvantages 为题写一篇 120 词左右的议论文。请列出三段式提纲（每段写出主题句），并写出全文的论点句与结论句。
items.answer: 【第一段 引出与论点】主题句：Online learning has become part of college life, and it is a double-edged sword. 论点句：In my opinion, online learning brings more convenience than problems as long as students can manage themselves.
items.analysis: 评分维度：内容 6 分——利与弊各至少两点并有例证；结构 4 分——三段清楚、主题句与论点句呼应、衔接词得当（first／besides／however／therefore）；语言 5 分——论点句用 In my opinion…，利弊句可用动名词或形式主语作主语，避免 there have、I think it very much good 之类中式表达。易失分点：只列利弊不作评价、第二三段主题句与论点句矛盾、缺少结论句。

items.stem: 下面是一名学生议论文的片段，请指出其中的三处问题并改正，然后写出修改后的段落主题句。片段：There have many students think that part-time jobs are waste of time. But I think part-time job is good. On the one hand, it can make us get money. On the other hand, it is also bad.
items.answer: 【问题一】There have many students think… 是典型中式表达：there be 句型不能与 have 连用，也不能直接跟动词原形。改：Many students think that part-time jobs are a waste of time.
items.analysis: 评分维度：内容 6 分——能准确定位 there have、缺冠词、可数名词单复数、逻辑自相矛盾四类错误并改对三处；结构 4 分——修改后的主题句能统领全段，不再自相矛盾；语言 5 分——改后句子语法正确、用词得当（a waste of time、do more good than harm 等固定表达）。易失分点：只指出错误不改、把 there have 改成 there has、保留 On the other hand 却仍与前句对立。

items.stem: You are describing a chart in an English report. The chart shows that the percentage of students using mobile payment rose from 45% in 2020 to 87% in 2024. Which sentence best describes the trend?
options: The percentage of students using mobile payment rose from 87% in 2020 to 45% in 2024.
The percentage of students using mobile payment rose from 45% in 2020 to 87% in 2024.
The number of students using mobile payment was 45 in 2020 and 87 in 2024.
Students use mobile payment because the chart is very clear.
items.analysis: 图表描述必须让数据与趋势一致。A 的年份与百分比对应正确，用 rose from ... to ... 表达上升，是标准的图表描述句。B 把两个年份的数据颠倒；C 把百分比当成人数，number 与 percentage 不符；D 与图表数据无关，也不是描述句。

items.stem: A table shows that library visits fell by 30% while online reading rose by 50%. Which sentence is the best summary of the table?
options: The table shows some numbers about reading habits.
Library visits and online reading both fell sharply.
While library visits dropped sharply, online reading grew even faster.
Online reading is less popular than visiting the library.
items.analysis: 概括句要抓住两条相反的趋势并体现对比关系，while 引导对比状语从句最贴切。B 与表格数据相反（网上阅读是上升）；C 只是空泛的交代，没有概括内容；D 与 50% 高于 30% 的事实相反。

items.stem: Sales jumped from 100 units in January to 900 units in June. Which adverb best completes the sentence: Sales rose ___ from January to June?
items.analysis: 100 到 900 是近九倍的增长，属于大幅上升，用 sharply（急剧地）最准确。slightly 表示轻微上升，与数据不符；rarely 表示频率低，hardly 表示几乎不，都不能修饰上升的幅度。
